description: Implementation of the ReportingCache class managing reporting reports, endpoints, groups, and clients, including adding, removing, evicting, and serializing reports and endpoints, with internal consistency checks.

classes.name: ReportingCacheImpl
classes.description: Main class implementing reporting cache management, including reports, endpoints, groups, clients, and related operations.

classes.name: ReportingCacheImpl::Client
classes.description: Represents a client with network anonymization key, origin, endpoint count, group names, and last used time.

classes.name: ReportingCacheImpl::ReportingReport
classes.description: Represents a reporting report with status, queued time, attempts, and associated data.

classes.name: ReportingCacheImpl::ReportingEndpoint
classes.description: Represents an endpoint with URL, priority, weight, and statistics.

classes.name: ReportingCacheImpl::CachedReportingEndpointGroup
classes.description: Represents a cached endpoint group with key, include_subdomains, expiry, last used, and endpoints.

classes.name: ReportingCacheImpl::ReportingEndpointGroupKey
classes.description: Key identifying an endpoint group, including network anonymization key, origin, group name, and optional reporting source.

classes.name: ReportingCacheImpl::Statistics
classes.description: Statistics for an endpoint, including upload attempts, successes, and reports.

methods.name: AddReport
methods.description: Adds a new report to the cache, evicting oldest if exceeding max count.

methods.name: GetReports
methods.description: Retrieves active reports excluding doomed and successful.

methods.name: GetReportsAsValue
methods.description: Serializes reports into a sorted list of dictionaries.

methods.name: GetReportsToDeliver
methods.description: Marks and returns reports pending delivery.

methods.name: GetReportsToDeliverForSource
methods.description: Marks and returns reports for a specific source pending delivery.

methods.name: ClearReportsPending
methods.description: Resets pending reports to queued or removes if done.

methods.name: GetCandidateEndpointsForDelivery
methods.description: Returns endpoints suitable for delivery based on group key, considering V1 and V0 logic.

methods.name: GetV1ReportingEndpointsByOrigin
methods.description: Returns all V1 reporting endpoints grouped by origin.

methods.name: GetEndpointForTesting
methods.description: Retrieves specific endpoint for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetV1EndpointForTesting
methods.description: Retrieves specific V1 endpoint for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetEndpointCountInGroup
methods.description: Returns number of endpoints in a specific group.

methods.name: SetV1EndpointForTesting
methods.description: Sets a V1 endpoint for testing.

methods.name: GetIsolationInfoForEndpoint
methods.description: Returns isolation info for a given endpoint.

methods.name: GetAllOrigins
methods.description: Returns all origins with cached clients.
